linux.summary: Record what your computer plays, straight to MP3
linux.description:
Sound Scraper records the audio your computer plays, from every app or just one, straight to MP3.

- Record, pause and stop, with a live visualizer
- A library of your recordings, with tag editing and cover art
- Split recordings into tracks, make playlists and burn CDs
- Skins for the WinAMP-style player
